---
description: Documentation rules for Markdown, docs, comments, READMEs, and architecture notes.
applyTo: "**/*.md,docs/**/*"
---
# Documentation rules

- Keep documentation consistent with the implementation and actual commands.
- Prefer concise examples that can be copied and run.
- Link concepts to concrete repository paths where useful.
- Do not document planned behavior as if it already exists.
- Update setup, migration, API, or operational documentation when a code change materially affects it.
